propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a controls technician and then controls software engineer at a materials handling company for six years, writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven conveyor and sortation lines under the company's software standard and commissioning nine of them on site.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the roles, the years, the lines and the commissioning.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering with the honours top-up started and not completed, implemented the safety functions to the safety engineer's specification with the verification signed by the safety engineer, and wrote the as-built documentation and boundary notes for the eleven lines.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the diploma certificate document the education, the safety function work and the documentation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds an accredited engineering degree in electrical engineering and has signed safety function verifications.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the diploma certificate document a Higher National Diploma with an uncompleted top-up, and the safety verifications signed by the safety engineer; the degree appears only in the screen and the LinkedIn education section.

expectedGap: The materials document a Higher National Diploma with an uncompleted honours top-up and safety verifications signed by the safety engineer; they do not document an accredited engineering degree or the candidate signing a safety function verification.
expectedBoundaryNote: State the qualification as the diploma certificate gives it and keep the safety function verification with the safety engineer.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the awarding institution's record of the top-up award, or a statement that no degree has been awarded.
